1090002: Meet Baby Girl- A turquoise jelly with purple and blue flakes. Megan (@brbdoingmynails) is our spotlight swatcher for this collection. Here's what she had to say about the polish and the name: "Baby Girl was made in memory of my grandmother, Jo Ann, who we lost to Acute Myeloid Leukemia. She had the best sense of humor, was incredibly fashionable, and was everyone's Gramma. Because of the scientists and doctors who found a treatment that worked well for her, we were able to hear her call us Baby Girl for three more years. I hope that the donations from this polish can help even one person spend extra time with the people who mean as much to them as they do to me." Charity spotlight: Blood Cancer United (bloodcancerunited.org) Blood Cancer United is on a mission to cure blood cancer and improve the quality of life for patients and their families. Founded in 1949 and formerly known as the Leukemia and Lymphoma Society, the organization funds research, provides free information and support services, and advocates for access to quality, affordable care. They are the single largest nonprofit funder of blood cancer research and have helped advance more than 70% of the blood cancer treatments approved by the FDA over the last two decades. $7.00 from every bottle sold goes to Blood Cancer United

Avery designed both shades in this duo, and she chose to support the Tennessee Aquarium. Noctiluca is inspired by the Tennessee Aquarium’s Ocean Journey exhibit, which explores the vast, mysterious world beyond our rivers where the deep sea holds endless questions, hidden life, and discoveries yet to be made. We both live in Tennessee, and the Aquarium is something we genuinely love. It is one of those places that makes you slow down and pay attention. For me, it brings back memories of visiting with my son and watching him get completely pulled into the exhibits. The deep ocean side always felt especially magical, a little mysterious, and full of questions. Plus, there are sharks.
